summary: Job is asked whether he can draw Leviathan out with a hook. Isaiah calls it the fleeing, twisting serpent, while the psalm describes God crushing its heads.

senses.definition: Leviathan is the sea creature whose heads Yahweh crushes and gives as food to the desert people.

note: Ugaritic ltn is called a fleeing serpent in a parallel phrase to Isa 27:1. The full Hebrew noun supplies the key. A derivation from לוה is uncertain.

evidence.locator: Glossary, ltn, and text 88.54 (KTU 1.5 I.1–3), ltn btn brḥ
